subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"impart."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Impart"** means to communicate or convey information or knowledge to someone. (अन्‍य व्‍यक्तियों को जानकारी पहुँचाना, ज्ञान प्रदान करना)

 
 
• **Example:** *I was rather quiet as I didn't feel I had much wisdom to **impart**__ on the subject.*
 
 
 
• The grammatical structure of the sentence suggests that a verb is needed to fill in the blank, and **"impart" **is the only verb option.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• **Correct passage:**

The Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA) or National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM) Scheme has been formulated to __**impart**__ IT training to 52.5 lakh persons, including Anganwadi and ASHA workers and authorised ration dealers in all the States/UTS ______ (2) ______ the country so that the non-IT literate citizens are ______ (3) ______ to become IT literate so as to ______ (4) ______ them to actively and effectively participate in the democratic and developmental process and also ______ (5) ______ their livelihood.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Attribute" **means to assign or credit something to a particular cause or source. (कारण ठहरना, उत्तरदायी मानना, श्रेय देना)
 
• **"Attain"** means to achieve or reach a goal or objective. ((किसी कार्य या वस्‍तु को) करने या पाने में सफल होना, विशेषतः काफ़ी प्रयत्‍न के बाद)
 
• **"Affirm" **means to declare or assert something as true or factual. (औपचारिक रूप से किसी बात को सही मानना; निश्‍चयपूर्वक समर्थन करना)
